WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.Name,
    AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / CAST(t.Milliseconds AS REAL)) as avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track t 
  JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId 
  GROUP BY mt.Name
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) as global_avg
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  step1.Name,
  step1.avg_bytes_per_ms,
  step1.avg_bytes_per_ms / step2.global_avg as ratio
FROM step1, step2
WHERE step2.global_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY step1.Name
